messages:
maria_cs: Weekly account health check-in for KeyOnboards — sharing error-rate breakdown and top failing endpoints. TL;DR: 5xx spike overnight, some timeouts and a small bump in rate-limits. Need SRE + Eng eyes.

dan_prod: Can you drop the 24h numbers and top URI list? we'll need that for the renewal risk notes.

maria_cs: 24h rolling window numbers: 5xx = 3.9% (+1.2pp vs last wk), timeouts = 1.6% (+0.4pp), rate-limits = 0.8% (+0.3pp). Token spend stable. Latency p95 up from 320ms -> 540ms for affected routes.

opsbot: [alert] 05:12 UTC — 5xx surge detected for customer KeyOnboards (eu-west-1). Peak error rate 12% for 10m window.

lee_sre: Looking at logs: majority of 5xx are 503/504 from runtime-03 pool. Error pattern shows repeated upstream grpc timeouts + occasional OOM in llama-kernel.

anya_eng: We pushed a micro-optim to kv-cache last night that could increase memory pressure for long prefix runs. Rolling change was small but could explain runtime-03 OOMs.

julia_cs: Customer impact: 8 active accounts saw degraded throughput, 2 have opened support tickets and one (AcmeCo) flagged as at-risk for renewal if not resolved by EOD.

maria_cs: Top failing endpoints (by fraction of 5xx volume):
- /v1/generate : 45% of 5xx (high concurrency text-gen paths)
- /v1/embed : 20% (batch embeds timed out)
- /v1/chat   : 18% (long-context chat with large KV cache)
- /v1/batch  : 10% (bulk requests hitting throughput limits)
- /v1/retry  : 7%  (retry storms observed)

dan_prod: Any specific client patterns? large batch sizes / long prompts?

lee_sre: Yes — correlation with requests that have prompt_length > 8k tokens and batch_size > 16. Also a small fraction originate from eu-west heavy accounts with pinned models.

anya_eng: Repro steps (from a failing trace):
```
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-llama-70b-q4",
  "prompt": "<~8k tokens...>",
  "max_tokens": 2048,
  "stream": false
}
```
Response: 503 grpc "upstream closed" or connection reset after ~6s.

lee_sre: Immediate mitigation suggestions:
- drain runtime-03 from routing (canary)
- apply emergency OOM guard in serving runtime to reject >6k prefix requests (soft cap)
- enable additional retry/backoff on client-facing proxy for heavy batch routes

maria_cs: CS asks: can we get a short note to customers (one-paragraph) we can send to the 8 affected accounts? Also want ETA for fixes + whether we can proactively offer credit.

anya_eng: We can hotfix kv-cache mem growth in next 90m, then staged rollout to runtimes. If that goes well, expect error rate to drop to baseline in 2-4h.

lee_sre: I'll start draining runtime-03 and spin up 2 extra nodes for eu-west to absorb load. ETA 30m for drain + 45m for nodes.

dan_prod: For renewal risk doc — note: AcmeCo saw 60% request failures on /v1/generate during peak, advised outreach + credit offer. BrightScale saw degraded p95 but fewer errors.

julia_cs: I'll prep email template. Proposed copy: "We're investigating increased errors impacting generation endpoints in eu-west; a fix is being rolled out and we expect normal service within a few hours — we'll follow up with a credit if service impacted your workflows." OK? :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Perfect. Action items: 1) SRE (lee_sre) drain + extra nodes; 2) Eng (anya_eng) hotfix in 90m; 3) CS (julia_cs, maria_cs) outbound to affected accounts + offer credit; 4) Prod (dan_prod) update renewal risk tracker. I'll post status update in 1h.

opsbot: [incident] runtime-03 drained at 1992467975, nodes added to eu-west at 1992468110.

lee_sre: Post-drain quick check: 5xx down to 1.1% in last 10m, timeouts trending down. Will monitor for 2h.

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll notify AcmeCo and BrightScale and add notes to the renewal risk doc. Will update thread when customers acknowledge. :eyes:
